description: Ping0 环境检测公开客户端的静态契约；记录采集路径和输出，不重建隐藏服务器判分，也不认证 VPN 或设备

scope.source_pin_scope: Only the exact reviewed client resources; not the backend, remote engine catalog, third-party services, redirects, or an iPad's loaded script identity
scope.analysis_method: Read source and pre-existing static constant views; no target JavaScript execution or evaluation

reading_conventions.locations: Line numbers are one-based in the captured original files. char_start and char_range are zero-based Unicode code-point offsets in the original single-line probes resource; char_range is half-open, not a byte range or a decoded-view offset
reading_conventions.local_names: cdn-main.js, cdn-probes-index.js, cdn-browser-detect.client.js and cdn-i18n.js name the reviewed snapshots of the pinned URLs, not files required at runtime
reading_conventions.types: Output type arrays describe the intended JSON shape on the reviewed ordinary path. They are not evidence of runtime type validation. json means any JSON value with its actual type retained. Missing, empty, zero, false and null remain distinct
reading_conventions.field_locations: Each output's source_refs identifies its producer. A job's source_refs also supplies shared implementation and main dispatch context
reading_conventions.untrusted_server_values: Most server-derived properties are passed through or defaulted with ||, without type checks. Unexpected values are malformed or unknown observations, never silently converted into a passing value
reading_conventions.crosschecks: Input candidates are analyst mappings from labels and client fields, not recovered backend dependencies or predicates
reading_conventions.static_views: Pre-existing literal/constant expansions are reading aids, not executable code or a proof of whole-bundle equivalence

scoring.application: Each finding may overwrite row.value/fail/severity/pending. score, level and report id are assigned from response. finalEvidence = resp.evidence || previous finalEvidence at cdn-main.js:506

collector_policy.context: One independent browser context, foreground page, listeners armed before navigation
collector_policy.deadline_result: Retain partial facts and explicit pending/failure/cleanup state at the deadline; do not extend the window or label pending as pass
collector_policy.offline: Replay parses retained data without network/CDP/device adapter imports or target-code execution

evidence_layers.facts: Captured request/response, source identity and original client submission with transaction/scope binding; distinguish missing, blocked, unavailable and truncated
evidence_layers.observation: Deterministic projections of facts such as observed IP set, timers, empty/fallback candidates; must cite supporting facts
evidence_layers.site_result: The site's returned score/level/findings/evidence. This is what the site said, not an independently verified rule or diagnosis
evidence_layers.diagnosis: Bounded interpretation with alternatives and unknowns; never derive system DNS failure, Fake-IP cause or VPN acceptance from a single site flag
evidence_layers.separation_rule: Do not fill facts.client_submission from Vue finalEvidence, findings.value or response.evidence

privacy.repository_policy: Do not commit raw captures, browser storage, credentials, tokens or complete target sources; runtime evidence belongs in the separately approved gated run directory
privacy.offline_policy: No requests, devices, site-code evaluation, directory-as-runtime-library dependency or implicit collection from old runs
